question:
A patient after chest injury has severe breathlessness, a hyper-resonant chest and a shifting trachea. The nurse should:

छाती की चोट के बाद रोगी को तेज़ साँस की तकलीफ, अति-गुंजायमान छाती और श्वासनली का विस्थापन है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Prepare for immediate needle decompression as ordered
आदेश अनुसार तत्काल सुई से दबाव निकालने की तैयारी करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A tension pneumothorax is a life-threatening emergency needing immediate decompression

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Wait for the doctor
डॉक्टर की प्रतीक्षा करें: Waiting risks cardiac arrest

C — Give oral fluids
मुँह से तरल दें: Oral fluids are unsafe here

D — Apply a tight chest bandage
छाती पर कसकर पट्टी बाँधें: A tight bandage worsens breathing and does not relieve the pressure

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch for falling blood pressure with a rising jugular venous pressure, which indicates the pressure is affecting the heart
option_1:
Wait for the doctor
डॉक्टर की प्रतीक्षा करें
option_2:
Prepare for immediate needle decompression as ordered
आदेश अनुसार तत्काल सुई से दबाव निकालने की तैयारी करें
option_4:
Apply a tight chest bandage
छाती पर कसकर पट्टी बाँधें

question:
A patient has a chest drain after a haemothorax, and 800 mL of blood drains in one hour. The nurse should:

हीमोथोरेक्स के बाद रोगी को छाती की नली लगी है और एक घंटे में 800 मि.ली. रक्त निकलता है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Report at once, as rapid bleeding suggests active haemorrhage
तुरंत रिपोर्ट करें, क्योंकि तेज़ रक्तस्राव सक्रिय रक्तस्राव दर्शाता है

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Rapid drainage suggests continued bleeding, so it is reported immediately

🔍 Key Clues: 800 mL

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Massage the chest
छाती की मालिश करें: Massage does not help and may cause pain

B — Clamp the drain and wait
नली को बंद करके प्रतीक्षा करें: Clamping can cause a tension pneumothorax

D — Ignore it if the patient is calm
रोगी शांत हो तो नजरअंदाज करें: A large loss must never be ignored, because shock may follow

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Monitor the pulse, blood pressure and the drain amount, and be prepared for transfusion
option_2:
Clamp the drain and wait
नली को बंद करके प्रतीक्षा करें
option_3:
Report at once, as rapid bleeding suggests active haemorrhage
तुरंत रिपोर्ट करें, क्योंकि तेज़ रक्तस्राव सक्रिय रक्तस्राव दर्शाता है
option_4:
Ignore it if the patient is calm
रोगी शांत हो तो नजरअंदाज करें

question:
A head-injured patient has blood behind the eardrum and clear fluid leaking from the nose. The nurse should:

सिर की चोट वाले रोगी के कान के पीछे रक्त और नाक से साफ द्रव का रिसाव है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Keep the head raised, allow the fluid to drain freely and report
सिर ऊँचा रखें, द्रव को स्वतंत्र रूप से बहने दें और रिपोर्ट करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A basal skull fracture with CSF leak is managed with the head raised and free drainage while it is reported

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Pack the nose and ear tightly
नाक और कान कसकर भर दें: Packing traps infection and raises intracranial pressure

B — Suction the nose firmly
नाक की जोर से सफाई करें: Nasal suctioning risks infection and injury

C — Give nose drops
नाक की बूँदें डालें: Nose drops are not given

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Never insert anything into the nose or ear, and watch for signs of meningitis
option_1:
Pack the nose and ear tightly
नाक और कान कसकर भर दें
option_2:
Suction the nose firmly
नाक की जोर से सफाई करें
option_4:
Keep the head raised, allow the fluid to drain freely and report
सिर ऊँचा रखें, द्रव को स्वतंत्र रूप से बहने दें और रिपोर्ट करें

question:
A patient with epilepsy should be advised to:

मिर्गी वाले रोगी को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Take the drugs regularly and avoid triggers such as sleep loss and alcohol
दवाएँ नियमित लें और नींद की कमी तथा शराब जैसे कारकों से बचें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Regular medication and trigger avoidance keep seizures controlled

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Take an extra dose on a bad day
खराब दिन पर अतिरिक्त खुराक लें: Extra doses without advice are dangerous

B — Avoid all activity
सारी गतिविधि छोड़ दें: Most normal activities are safe with precautions

C — Stop the drug when fit-free
दौरे बंद होने पर दवा बंद कर दें: Stopping suddenly can cause severe seizures

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Advise the patient to avoid swimming alone and to carry identification
option_1:
Take an extra dose on a bad day
खराब दिन पर अतिरिक्त खुराक लें
option_3:
Stop the drug when fit-free
दौरे बंद होने पर दवा बंद कर दें
option_4:
Take the drugs regularly and avoid triggers such as sleep loss and alcohol
दवाएँ नियमित लें और नींद की कमी तथा शराब जैसे कारकों से बचें

question:
Sudden one-sided facial droop with inability to close the eye is typical of:

अचानक एक तरफ चेहरे का झुकना और आँख बंद न कर पाना किसका लक्षण है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Bell's palsy
बेल्स पाल्सी

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Bell's palsy causes sudden one-sided facial weakness with an inability to close the eye

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Migraine
अधकपारी: Migraine causes headache and visual changes

C — Stroke
आघात: A stroke may also cause facial weakness but usually spares the forehead

D — Trigeminal neuralgia
ट्राइजेमिनल न्यूराल्जिया: Trigeminal neuralgia causes sharp facial pain

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Protect the eye with lubricants and a pad, because it may not close

question:
A patient with Meniere's disease during a vertigo attack should:

मेनियर रोग वाले रोगी को चक्कर के दौरे के दौरान क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Lie down in a quiet, dimly lit room and avoid sudden head movement
शांत, कम रोशनी वाले कमरे में लेटें और सिर को अचानक न हिलाएँ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Resting in a quiet, dim room and avoiding head movement reduces vertigo

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Walk quickly
तेज़ चलें: Walking during vertigo risks a fall

C — Drink strong coffee
तेज़ कॉफी पिएँ: Caffeine may worsen symptoms

D — Stand and bend forward
खड़े होकर आगे झुकें: Sudden changes in posture worsen vertigo

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Assist the patient during an attack and give the prescribed drugs
option_2:
Lie down in a quiet, dimly lit room and avoid sudden head movement
शांत, कम रोशनी वाले कमरे में लेटें और सिर को अचानक न हिलाएँ
option_4:
Stand and bend forward
खड़े होकर आगे झुकें

question:
A patient with chronic venous insufficiency should be advised to:

दीर्घकालिक शिरा अपर्याप्तता वाले रोगी को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Elevate the legs and use compression stockings as advised
पैर ऊँचे रखें और सलाह अनुसार कम्प्रेशन स्टॉकिंग पहनें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Elevation and compression improve venous return and reduce swelling

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Wear tight shoes
तंग जूते पहनें: Tight shoes do not help and cause discomfort

C — Stand for long periods
लंबे समय तक खड़े रहें: Prolonged standing increases venous pooling

D — Keep the legs dangling
पैर लटकाए रखें: Dangling the legs worsens stasis

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Inspect the skin for ulcers, because poor return delays healing
option_1:
Elevate the legs and use compression stockings as advised
पैर ऊँचे रखें और सलाह अनुसार कम्प्रेशन स्टॉकिंग पहनें
option_3:
Stand for long periods
लंबे समय तक खड़े रहें

question:
Enlarged, twisted superficial veins of the legs are called:

पैरों की बढ़ी हुई, मुड़ी हुई सतही शिराओं को क्या कहते हैं:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Varicose veins
वैरिकोज़ वेन्स

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Varicose veins are enlarged, twisted superficial veins of the legs

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Deep vein thrombosis
गहरी शिरा घनास्त्रता: Deep vein thrombosis is a clot in a deep vein

B — Gangrene
गैंग्रीन: Gangrene is dead tissue

C — Cellulitis
सेल्युलाइटिस: Cellulitis is a skin infection

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Prolonged standing and pregnancy raise the risk, and compression helps symptoms

question:
A patient with acute gastritis should be advised to:

तीव्र गैस्ट्राइटिस वाले रोगी को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Avoid irritants such as alcohol, NSAIDs and spicy food
शराब, एनएसएआईडी और मसालेदार भोजन जैसे उत्तेजक से बचें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Avoiding gastric irritants helps the inflamed lining heal

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Drink strong coffee
तेज़ कॉफी पिएँ: Coffee increases acid

C — Take spicy food
मसालेदार भोजन लें: Spicy food irritates the stomach

D — Skip all meals
सारे भोजन छोड़ दें: Regular small bland meals are better than skipping food

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Pearl: Give prescribed antacids or acid suppressants and watch for bleeding
option_1:
Avoid irritants such as alcohol, NSAIDs and spicy food
शराब, एनएसएआईडी और मसालेदार भोजन जैसे उत्तेजक से बचें

question:
A patient with irritable bowel syndrome is best helped by:

इरिटेबल बाउल सिंड्रोम वाले रोगी की सर्वोत्तम सहायता किससे होती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Reassurance, dietary fibre adjustment and stress reduction
तसल्ली, आहार में रेशे का समायोजन और तनाव में कमी

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Irritable bowel syndrome is managed with reassurance, diet changes and stress reduction, as no structural disease is present

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Routine antibiotics
नियमित एंटीबायोटिक: Routine antibiotics are not used

B — Complete bed rest
पूर्ण विश्राम: Complete bed rest is not advised

C — Strong laxatives daily
प्रतिदिन तेज़ जुलाब: Strong laxatives can worsen symptoms

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Pearl: Reassurance matters, because the symptoms are real but not dangerous
option_4:
Reassurance, dietary fibre adjustment and stress reduction
तसल्ली, आहार में रेशे का समायोजन और तनाव में कमी

question:
A patient with chronic pancreatitis has greasy stools and weight loss. The nurse should:

दीर्घकालिक अग्नाशयशोथ वाले रोगी को चिकनाईयुक्त मल और वजन घटना है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Give prescribed pancreatic enzymes with meals and a low-fat diet
भोजन के साथ निर्धारित अग्नाशयी एंजाइम और कम वसा वाला आहार दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Pancreatic enzymes replace the deficiency, and a low-fat diet reduces symptoms

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give a high-fat diet
अधिक वसा वाला आहार दें: A high-fat diet worsens the stools

C — Restrict all fluids
सभी तरल रोक दें: Fluid restriction is not indicated

D — Avoid all protein
सारा प्रोटीन छोड़ दें: Protein is needed for nutrition

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Pearl: Advise patients to avoid alcohol and to take enzymes with every meal
option_1:
Give a high-fat diet
अधिक वसा वाला आहार दें
option_2:
Give prescribed pancreatic enzymes with meals and a low-fat diet
भोजन के साथ निर्धारित अग्नाशयी एंजाइम और कम वसा वाला आहार दें

question:
The most common type of incontinence in older women after childbirth is:

प्रसव के बाद वृद्ध महिलाओं में सबसे सामान्य मूत्र असंयम कौन-सा है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Stress incontinence
तनाव असंयम

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Stress incontinence causes leakage on coughing, sneezing or laughing after weakened pelvic muscles

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Functional incontinence
कार्यात्मक असंयम: Functional incontinence relates to access problems

C — Overflow incontinence
अतिप्रवाह असंयम: Overflow incontinence results from incomplete bladder emptying

D — Reflex incontinence
प्रतिवर्ती असंयम: Reflex incontinence relates to nerve damage

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Pelvic floor exercises and weight reduction help stress incontinence

question:
While giving chemotherapy a patient complains of burning at the infusion site. The nurse should:

कीमोथेरेपी देते समय रोगी को टपकन स्थल पर जलन की शिकायत है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Stop the infusion at once, leave the cannula in place and follow the extravasation protocol
अंतःशिरा तुरंत रोकें, कैनुला लगी रहने दें और एक्स्ट्रावेसेशन प्रोटोकॉल अपनाएँ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Extravasation is managed by stopping the infusion, keeping the cannula and following the protocol

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Massage the site
स्थान की मालिश करें: Massage worsens the injury

C — Flush the line with water
लाइन को पानी से बहा दें: Flushing spreads the drug into the tissue

D — Continue the infusion
अंतःशिरा जारी रखें: Continuing causes tissue damage

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Apply the prescribed antidote and cold or warm compress as directed, and document the event
option_1:
Stop the infusion at once, leave the cannula in place and follow the extravasation protocol
अंतःशिरा तुरंत रोकें, कैनुला लगी रहने दें और एक्स्ट्रावेसेशन प्रोटोकॉल अपनाएँ
option_3:
Flush the line with water
लाइन को पानी से बहा दें

question:
A patient receiving radiotherapy should be advised to:

रेडियोथेरेपी ले रहे रोगी को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Keep the treated area clean, dry and protected from sun, and avoid irritants
उपचारित क्षेत्र को साफ, सूखा और धूप से सुरक्षित रखें तथा उत्तेजक पदार्थों से बचें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Keeping the treated area clean, dry and protected prevents skin reactions

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Rub and scrub the treated skin
उपचारित त्वचा को रगड़ें और साफ करें: Rubbing damages the delicate skin

C — Apply strong perfume
तेज़ इत्र लगाएँ: Perfume irritates the skin

D — Use a hot water bag on the area
उस क्षेत्र पर गर्म पानी की थैली लगाएँ: Heat increases skin damage

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Use only prescribed lotions and mark the treatment area as instructed
option_1:
Rub and scrub the treated skin
उपचारित त्वचा को रगड़ें और साफ करें
option_2:
Keep the treated area clean, dry and protected from sun, and avoid irritants
उपचारित क्षेत्र को साफ, सूखा और धूप से सुरक्षित रखें तथा उत्तेजक पदार्थों से बचें
option_4:
Use a hot water bag on the area
उस क्षेत्र पर गर्म पानी की थैली लगाएँ

question:
During cardiac arrest, the pulse is best checked at the:

हृदय रुकने पर नाड़ी सबसे अच्छी तरह कहाँ देखी जाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Carotid artery
कैरोटिड धमनी

🧠 Clinical Rationale: In a collapse the carotid pulse is the most reliable central pulse to check

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Popliteal artery
पॉप्लिटियल धमनी: The popliteal pulse is difficult to feel

C — Femoral artery
फीमोरल धमनी: The femoral pulse is central but less accessible

D — Radial artery
रेडियल धमनी: The radial pulse may be absent in shock

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Check the pulse for no more than ten seconds so that compressions begin quickly

question:
A sitz bath is most useful for:

सिट्ज़ स्नान सर्वाधिक किसलिए उपयोगी है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Relieving perineal pain and promoting healing
पेरिनियल दर्द कम करने और भरने को बढ़ावा देने के लिए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A warm sitz bath soothes the perineum after delivery or surgery and aids healing

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Treating chest pain
छाती के दर्द के इलाज के लिए: It does not treat chest pain

C — Lowering blood pressure
रक्तचाप कम करने के लिए: It does not lower blood pressure

D — Increasing appetite
भूख बढ़ाने के लिए: It does not increase appetite

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Keep the water comfortably warm, limit the bath to about 15 to 20 minutes and help the patient in and out safely
option_1:
Treating chest pain
छाती के दर्द के इलाज के लिए
option_2:
Relieving perineal pain and promoting healing
पेरिनियल दर्द कम करने और भरने को बढ़ावा देने के लिए
option_3:
Lowering blood pressure
रक्तचाप कम करने के लिए

question:
An unconscious patient's eyes should be cared for by:

अचेतन रोगी की आँखों की देखभाल कैसे करनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Cleaning gently and keeping them closed or lubricated to prevent dryness
धीरे से साफ करें और सूखने से बचाने के लिए बंद या चिकना रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Gentle cleaning with protection from dryness prevents corneal damage in an unconscious patient

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Leaving them open
उन्हें खुला छोड़ दें: Open eyes dry out and may ulcerate

B — Applying strong antiseptic
तेज़ एंटीसेप्टिक लगाएँ: Strong antiseptics irritate the eye

D — Rubbing them firmly
उन्हें जोर से रगड़ें: Rubbing damages the cornea

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Check the corneal reflex and tape the lids closed if needed
option_3:
Cleaning gently and keeping them closed or lubricated to prevent dryness
धीरे से साफ करें और सूखने से बचाने के लिए बंद या चिकना रखें

question:
The safest way to move a heavy patient is to:

भारी रोगी को हिलाने का सबसे सुरक्षित तरीका क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Use a hoist or slide sheet with enough helpers
पर्याप्त सहायकों के साथ होइस्ट या स्लाइड शीट का उपयोग करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Using a hoist or slide sheet with help protects both the patient and the nurse

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Lift alone quickly
अकेले जल्दी उठाएँ: Lifting alone risks injury to both

B — Bend the back and twist
कमर झुकाकर मोड़ें: Bending and twisting injures the back

D — Pull by the arms
बाँहों से खींचें: Pulling by the arms can dislocate the shoulder

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Plan the move, explain it and keep the load close to the body
option_2:
Bend the back and twist
कमर झुकाकर मोड़ें
option_3:
Use a hoist or slide sheet with enough helpers
पर्याप्त सहायकों के साथ होइस्ट या स्लाइड शीट का उपयोग करें

question:
For a sputum specimen, the nurse should collect:

थूक का नमूना लेते समय नर्स को क्या एकत्र करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. A deep cough specimen into a sterile container
बंध्य पात्र में गहरी खाँसी से निकला नमूना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A deep cough specimen gives the sputum from the lungs, not saliva

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Nasal secretions
नाक का स्राव: Nasal secretions are not sputum

B — Water gargle
पानी का गरारा: A water gargle is not a specimen

D — Saliva from the mouth
मुँह से लार: Saliva is not a useful specimen

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Collect the sample in the morning and send it promptly for the best result
option_3:
A deep cough specimen into a sterile container
बंध्य पात्र में गहरी खाँसी से निकला नमूना

question:
When instilling eye drops, the nurse should:

आँख में बूँदें डालते समय नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Pull the lower lid down, instil into the lower sac and avoid touching the eye
निचली पलक नीचे खींचें, निचली थैली में डालें और आँख को न छुएँ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The lower lid is pulled down and the drops are placed in the lower sac without touching the eye

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Touch the dropper to the eye
ड्रॉपर को आँख से छुआएँ: Touching the eye contaminates the dropper

C — Instil several drops at once
एक साथ कई बूँदें डालें: Only the prescribed number of drops is given

D — Put the drops on the closed lid
बंद पलक पर बूँदें डालें: Drops on a closed lid do not reach the eye

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Wait a few minutes between different eye medicines so that the first is not washed out
option_1:
Touch the dropper to the eye
ड्रॉपर को आँख से छुआएँ
option_2:
Pull the lower lid down, instil into the lower sac and avoid touching the eye
निचली पलक नीचे खींचें, निचली थैली में डालें और आँख को न छुएँ
option_3:
Instil several drops at once
एक साथ कई बूँदें डालें
option_4:
Put the drops on the closed lid
बंद पलक पर बूँदें डालें

question:
A patient has a corrugated rubber drain in a surgical wound. The nurse should:

रोगी के शल्य घाव में कॉरगेटेड रबर ड्रेन है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Note the type and amount of drainage and secure the drain
स्राव का प्रकार और मात्रा दर्ज करें तथा ड्रेन को सुरक्षित रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The drain is observed and secured, and its drainage is documented

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Push the drain deeper
ड्रेन को और गहरा करें: Pushing it deeper risks injury

B — Cut the drain shorter
ड्रेन को छोटा काट दें: Cutting it changes its function

C — Pull the drain out while changing the dressing
पट्टी बदलते समय ड्रेन खींचकर निकाल दें: Removing the drain without an order can cause harm

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Report a sudden increase in drainage or a change in its colour, which may indicate bleeding or infection
option_1:
Push the drain deeper
ड्रेन को और गहरा करें
option_2:
Cut the drain shorter
ड्रेन को छोटा काट दें
option_3:
Pull the drain out while changing the dressing
पट्टी बदलते समय ड्रेन खींचकर निकाल दें
option_4:
Note the type and amount of drainage and secure the drain
स्राव का प्रकार और मात्रा दर्ज करें तथा ड्रेन को सुरक्षित रखें

question:
The urinary drainage bag should be emptied:

मूत्र निकास थैली को कब खाली करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Regularly, using a separate container for each patient with care not to touch the outlet
नियमित रूप से, प्रत्येक रोगी के लिए अलग पात्र का उपयोग करते हुए और निकास को छुए बिना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The bag is emptied regularly with a separate container and without touching the outlet, to prevent infection

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Only when full
केवल भर जाने पर: Waiting until it is full causes backflow

B — By all staff from the same jug
सभी कर्मचारी एक ही जग से: Sharing a container spreads infection

C — Once a week
सप्ताह में एक बार: Once a week allows overfilling and infection

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Keep the bag below the level of the bladder and off the floor
option_2:
By all staff from the same jug
सभी कर्मचारी एक ही जग से
option_4:
Regularly, using a separate container for each patient with care not to touch the outlet
नियमित रूप से, प्रत्येक रोगी के लिए अलग पात्र का उपयोग करते हुए और निकास को छुए बिना

question:
Discharge planning should ideally begin:

डिस्चार्ज की योजना आदर्श रूप से कब शुरू होनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. On admission, and continue throughout the stay
भर्ती के समय, और पूरे प्रवास के दौरान जारी रहे

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Discharge planning starts on admission so that care and follow-up are well arranged

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Only if the patient asks
केवल तब जब रोगी पूछे: It should be proactive, not only on request

B — On the day of discharge
डिस्चार्ज के दिन: Planning on the day of discharge is too late

C — A week after discharge
डिस्चार्ज के एक सप्ताह बाद: Post-discharge planning misses the preparation

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Involve the patient, family and community services for a safe transition home
option_1:
Only if the patient asks
केवल तब जब रोगी पूछे
option_2:
On the day of discharge
डिस्चार्ज के दिन
option_3:
A week after discharge
डिस्चार्ज के एक सप्ताह बाद
option_4:
On admission, and continue throughout the stay
भर्ती के समय, और पूरे प्रवास के दौरान जारी रहे

question:
During menstruation a woman should be advised to:

मासिक धर्म के दौरान महिला को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Change the sanitary pad often and keep the area clean
सेनेटरी पैड बार-बार बदलें और क्षेत्र साफ रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Changing pads often and keeping clean prevents infection during menstruation

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Avoid all bathing
स्नान से बचें: Bathing is safe and helpful

C — Use a cloth for many days
कई दिनों तक कपड़ा उपयोग करें: Using a soiled cloth for days causes infection

D — Use unclean water
अपचित पानी उपयोग करें: Clean water is essential

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Teach adolescent girls about menstrual hygiene, as poor hygiene is a common cause of reproductive tract infection
option_2:
Change the sanitary pad often and keep the area clean
सेनेटरी पैड बार-बार बदलें और क्षेत्र साफ रखें
option_3:
Use a cloth for many days
कई दिनों तक कपड़ा उपयोग करें

question:
Postpartum perineal care should be done:

प्रसवोत्तर पेरिनियल देखभाल कैसे करनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. From front to back, using clean water and a fresh pad
आगे से पीछे की ओर, साफ पानी और नए पैड के साथ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Cleaning from front to back with clean water prevents infection of the perineum

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — With strong antiseptic daily
प्रतिदिन तेज़ एंटीसेप्टिक के साथ: Strong antiseptics irritate the tissue

C — From back to front
पीछे से आगे की ओर: Back-to-front carries organisms to the urethra

D — Without washing hands
हाथ धोए बिना: Hand hygiene is essential before and after

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Inspect the perineum for healing and report redness, discharge or gaping
option_1:
With strong antiseptic daily
प्रतिदिन तेज़ एंटीसेप्टिक के साथ
option_2:
From front to back, using clean water and a fresh pad
आगे से पीछे की ओर, साफ पानी और नए पैड के साथ
option_3:
From back to front
पीछे से आगे की ओर

question:
A woman in the first stage of labour has a rising pulse, dehydration and no cervical change for hours. The nurse should:

प्रथम चरण में प्रसवरत महिला की नाड़ी बढ़ रही है, निर्जलीकरण है और घंटों से गर्भाशय ग्रीवा में कोई बदलाव नहीं है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Report the slow progress, give fluids and keep the mother comfortable
धीमी प्रगति की रिपोर्ट करें, तरल दें और माँ को सहज रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Slow progress with maternal distress needs reporting, fluids and support while the cause is assessed

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ask her to push hard
उसे जोर से धक्का देने को कहें: Pushing before full dilatation wastes energy and injures the cervix

B — Leave her alone
उसे अकेला छोड़ दें: Continuous monitoring is essential

D — Give a sedative
नींद की दवा दें: Sedation without assessment is unsafe

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Prolonged labour risks infection, exhaustion and fetal distress
option_1:
Ask her to push hard
उसे जोर से धक्का देने को कहें
option_3:
Report the slow progress, give fluids and keep the mother comfortable
धीमी प्रगति की रिपोर्ट करें, तरल दें और माँ को सहज रखें

question:
On a cardiotocograph, late decelerations of the fetal heart are usually due to:

कार्डियोटोकोग्राफ पर भ्रूण हृदय का विलंबित मंदन सामान्यतः किस कारण होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Uteroplacental insufficiency
गर्भाशय-अपरा अपर्याप्तता

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Late decelerations suggest uteroplacental insufficiency and a compromised fetus

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Normal variation
सामान्य भिन्नता: Late decelerations are not a normal pattern

C — Cord compression
गर्भनाल दबाव: Variable decelerations suggest cord compression

D — Head compression
सिर का दबाव: Early decelerations relate to head compression

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Change the mother's position, give oxygen and report, because the fetus may be hypoxic

question:
A pregnant woman in the third trimester should report:

तीसरी तिमाही में गर्भवती महिला को क्या बताना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. A decrease in fetal movements
भ्रूण की हलचल में कमी

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A clear decrease in fetal movements may indicate fetal compromise and must be reported

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Slight fatigue
हल्की थकान: Mild fatigue is expected in pregnancy

B — Mild backache
हल्का कमर दर्द: Mild backache is common and usually harmless

C — Occasional leg cramp
कभी-कभी पैर में ऐंठन: Occasional cramps are common

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Teach the mother to count movements daily, because a reduced count needs urgent review
option_4:
A decrease in fetal movements
भ्रूण की हलचल में कमी

question:
Gestational diabetes is usually screened by:

गर्भकालीन मधुमेह की जाँच सामान्यतः किससे की जाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. An oral glucose tolerance test
मुँह से ग्लूकोज सहनशीलता परीक्षण

🧠 Clinical Rationale: An oral glucose tolerance test detects gestational diabetes

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — An ultrasound only
केवल अल्ट्रासाउंड: An ultrasound assesses the baby's growth, not glucose

B — A blood pressure check only
केवल रक्तचाप जाँच: Blood pressure screening detects pre-eclampsia

C — A urine culture
मूत्र संवर्धन: A urine culture detects infection

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Treating gestational diabetes reduces the risk of macrosomia and birth problems
option_2:
A blood pressure check only
केवल रक्तचाप जाँच
option_4:
An oral glucose tolerance test
मुँह से ग्लूकोज सहनशीलता परीक्षण

question:
A mother should be encouraged to bring the newborn for immunisation and check-up as per the schedule mainly to:

माँ को नवजात को टीकाकरण और जाँच के लिए कार्यक्रम अनुसार लाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करना मुख्यतः क्यों आवश्यक है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Detect problems early and complete immunisation on time
समस्याएँ जल्दी पकड़ने और समय पर टीकाकरण पूरा करने के लिए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Regular check-ups detect problems early and ensure timely immunisation

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Increase paperwork
कागजी कार्रवाई बढ़ाने के लिए: Follow-up is about health, not paperwork

B — Replace home care
घर की देखभाल बदलने के लिए: It complements home care

D — Reduce feeding
भोजन कम करने के लिए: It does not reduce feeding

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Growth monitoring at these visits helps detect malnutrition early
option_2:
Replace home care
घर की देखभाल बदलने के लिए
option_3:
Detect problems early and complete immunisation on time
समस्याएँ जल्दी पकड़ने और समय पर टीकाकरण पूरा करने के लिए

question:
A patient receiving pethidine for pain should be watched closely for:

दर्द के लिए पेथिडीन ले रहे रोगी की सतर्कता से निगरानी किसलिए करनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Respiratory depression and drowsiness
श्वसन अवसाद और तंद्रा

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Pethidine can depress breathing and cause drowsiness, so the respiratory rate is monitored

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Polyuria
अधिक मूत्र: Polyuria is not typical

C — Hypertension
उच्च रक्तचाप: It tends to lower, not raise, blood pressure

D — Weight gain
वजन बढ़ना: Weight gain is not typical

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Keep naloxone available, and give the drug only as prescribed
option_1:
Respiratory depression and drowsiness
श्वसन अवसाद और तंद्रा

question:
Unlike furosemide, spironolactone tends to:

फ्यूरोसेमाइड के विपरीत स्पाइरोनोलैक्टोन किस प्रवृत्ति का होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Raise the potassium level
पोटेशियम स्तर बढ़ाना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Spironolactone is potassium-sparing and can raise the potassium level

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Raise the blood sugar only
केवल रक्त शर्करा बढ़ाना: It does not mainly raise blood sugar

C — Cause severe potassium loss
गंभीर पोटेशियम हानि: It causes much less potassium loss than loop diuretics

D — Cause dehydration only
केवल निर्जलीकरण: Any diuretic can cause dehydration, but this is not the key difference

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Check the potassium and renal function, and avoid potassium supplements unless prescribed
option_1:
Raise the blood sugar only
केवल रक्त शर्करा बढ़ाना

question:
A patient with a documented penicillin allergy is prescribed a cephalosporin. The nurse should:

जिस रोगी को पेनिसिलिन से एलर्जी है उसे सेफलोस्पोरिन लिखा गया है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Confirm the prescription with the prescriber, as cross-reactivity is possible
क्रॉस-रिएक्टिविटी संभव होने के कारण नुस्खे की पुष्टि चिकित्सक से करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Some patients allergic to penicillin can react to cephalosporins, so the prescription is confirmed

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Give it without checking
बिना जाँच दें: Giving it without checking risks a reaction

C — Mix it with an antihistamine
एंटीहिस्टामिन के साथ मिलाएँ: Mixing drugs does not prevent allergy

D — Give half the dose first
पहले आधी खुराक दें: A test dose must be a medical decision

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Always check the allergy record and keep emergency drugs ready
option_1:
Confirm the prescription with the prescriber, as cross-reactivity is possible
क्रॉस-रिएक्टिविटी संभव होने के कारण नुस्खे की पुष्टि चिकित्सक से करें
option_3:
Mix it with an antihistamine
एंटीहिस्टामिन के साथ मिलाएँ
option_4:
Give half the dose first
पहले आधी खुराक दें

question:
An elderly patient on a sulfonylurea skips breakfast and becomes sweaty and shaky. The nurse should:

सल्फोनिलयूरिया ले रहे वृद्ध रोगी ने नाश्ता छोड़ा और पसीने के साथ काँपने लगा। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Treat it as hypoglycaemia with a fast glucose source and recheck the sugar
इसे हाइपोग्लाइसीमिया मानकर तेज़ ग्लूकोज दें और शर्करा दोबारा जाँचें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: These signs suggest hypoglycaemia, which is treated with a fast glucose source and reassessment

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give extra medicine
अतिरिक्त दवा दें: More medicine lowers the sugar further

B — Restrict all fluids
सभी तरल रोक दें: Fluids are not restricted

C — Give a high-fat meal
अधिक वसा वाला भोजन दें: A fatty meal is absorbed too slowly

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Advise regular meals, because sulfonylureas can cause hypoglycaemia, especially in the elderly
option_3:
Give a high-fat meal
अधिक वसा वाला भोजन दें
option_4:
Treat it as hypoglycaemia with a fast glucose source and recheck the sugar
इसे हाइपोग्लाइसीमिया मानकर तेज़ ग्लूकोज दें और शर्करा दोबारा जाँचें

question:
Atropine may be given to treat:

एट्रोपिन किसके उपचार के लिए दिया जा सकता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Symptomatic bradycardia
लक्षणयुक्त मंद हृदयगति

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Atropine increases the heart rate in symptomatic bradycardia

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Tachycardia
तेज़ हृदयगति: It is used for a slow, not fast, rate

B — Fever
बुखार: It does not reduce fever

D — Hypertension
उच्च रक्तचाप: It can raise the blood pressure slightly rather than lower it

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch the pulse and the mouth dryness, and note that atropine may cause blurred vision and urinary retention

question:
The best community measure to reduce road traffic injuries is:

सड़क दुर्घटनाओं की चोटें कम करने का सर्वोत्तम सामुदायिक उपाय क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Using helmets and seat belts, and enforcing speed limits
हेलमेट और सीट बेल्ट का उपयोग और गति सीमा का पालन

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Helmets, seat belts and speed control reduce deaths and injuries from road crashes

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ignoring traffic rules
यातायात नियमों की अनदेखी: Ignoring rules raises the risk

B — Removing road signs
सड़क चिह्न हटाना: Road signs guide safety

C — Driving faster
तेज़ गाड़ी चलाना: Speeding increases the severity of crashes

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Road traffic injuries are a leading cause of death in young adults, and many are preventable
option_4:
Using helmets and seat belts, and enforcing speed limits
हेलमेट और सीट बेल्ट का उपयोग और गति सीमा का पालन

question:
In disaster management, the phase of 'mitigation' refers to:

आपदा प्रबंधन में 'शमन' चरण का अर्थ क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Measures taken before a disaster to reduce its impact
आपदा से पहले उसके प्रभाव को कम करने के उपाय

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Mitigation means actions taken before a disaster to reduce its impact

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Rescue during the disaster
आपदा के दौरान बचाव: Rescue belongs to the response phase

B — Relief after the disaster
आपदा के बाद राहत: Relief belongs to the recovery phase

D — Counting the dead
मृतकों की गिनती: Counting losses is part of assessment

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Preparedness, training and early warning reduce the toll of disasters
option_1:
Rescue during the disaster
आपदा के दौरान बचाव
option_2:
Relief after the disaster
आपदा के बाद राहत
option_3:
Measures taken before a disaster to reduce its impact
आपदा से पहले उसके प्रभाव को कम करने के उपाय

question:
Residents near a factory report cough and eye irritation. The nurse should:

एक कारखाने के पास के निवासियों को खाँसी और आँखों में जलन की शिकायत है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Report the possible air pollution, advise protection and arrange health assessment
संभावित वायु प्रदूषण की रिपोर्ट करें, सुरक्षा की सलाह दें और स्वास्थ्य जाँच कराएँ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Suspected pollution is reported, exposure is reduced and the people are assessed

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ask them to work longer hours
उन्हें और घंटे काम करने को कहें: More exposure worsens the problem

B — Ignore the complaints
शिकायतों को नजरअंदाज करें: Ignoring the complaints endangers health

D — Provide only painkillers
केवल दर्द निवारक दें: Painkillers do not address the cause

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Air pollution affects the lungs, eyes and heart, and vulnerable groups suffer most
option_1:
Ask them to work longer hours
उन्हें और घंटे काम करने को कहें
option_3:
Report the possible air pollution, advise protection and arrange health assessment
संभावित वायु प्रदूषण की रिपोर्ट करें, सुरक्षा की सलाह दें और स्वास्थ्य जाँच कराएँ

question:
A district records 200 infant deaths among 5000 live births. The infant mortality rate is:

एक जिले में 5000 जीवित जन्मों में 200 शिशु मृत्यु दर्ज होती हैं। शिशु मृत्यु दर क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. 40 per 1000 live births
प्रति 1000 जीवित जन्मों पर 40

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Infant mortality rate = (200 ÷ 5000) × 1000 = 40 per 1000 live births

🔍 Key Clues: infant

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — 4 per 1000 live births
प्रति 1000 जीवित जन्मों पर 4: 4 is a decimal error

C — 400 per 1000 live births
प्रति 1000 जीवित जन्मों पर 400: 400 multiplies by ten

D — 20 per 1000 live births
प्रति 1000 जीवित जन्मों पर 20: 20 omits the scaling

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Infant mortality reflects the health of a community and is improved by immunisation and nutrition
option_1:
40 per 1000 live births
प्रति 1000 जीवित जन्मों पर 40
option_2:
4 per 1000 live births
प्रति 1000 जीवित जन्मों पर 4
option_3:
400 per 1000 live births
प्रति 1000 जीवित जन्मों पर 400
option_4:
20 per 1000 live births
प्रति 1000 जीवित जन्मों पर 20

question:
The most important measure to reduce maternal deaths in the community is:

समुदाय में मातृ मृत्यु कम करने का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण उपाय क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Skilled care during pregnancy and delivery with timely referral
गर्भावस्था और प्रसव के दौरान कुशल देखभाल के साथ समय पर रेफरल

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Skilled care and timely referral prevent most maternal deaths from haemorrhage, sepsis and eclampsia

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Early marriage
जल्दी विवाह: Early marriage increases risk

C — Avoiding antenatal care
प्रसवपूर्व देखभाल से बचना: Antenatal care is essential

D — Home delivery without help
बिना सहायता के घर प्रसव: Unattended home delivery is dangerous

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Institutional delivery with a skilled attendant saves lives
option_2:
Skilled care during pregnancy and delivery with timely referral
गर्भावस्था और प्रसव के दौरान कुशल देखभाल के साथ समय पर रेफरल
option_4:
Home delivery without help
बिना सहायता के घर प्रसव

question:
The period during which a person can spread an infectious disease is called the:

वह अवधि जिसमें व्यक्ति संक्रामक रोग फैला सकता है, उसे क्या कहते हैं:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Communicable period
संक्रामक काल

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The communicable period is when the person can pass the infection to others

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Incubation period
ऊष्मायन काल: The incubation period is before symptoms appear

B — Latent period
गुप्त काल: The latent period is dormant

D — Recovery period
स्वस्थ होने का काल: Recovery is after the illness

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Isolation is continued until the person is no longer infectious

question:
When a newborn's head is turned, the baby turns the whole body in the same direction. This reflex is:

नवजात का सिर घुमाने पर शिशु पूरा शरीर उसी दिशा में घुमा लेता है। यह प्रतिवर्त कौन-सा है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Asymmetric tonic neck reflex
असममित टॉनिक नेक प्रतिवर्त

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The asymmetric tonic neck reflex makes the baby extend one arm and bend the other when the head is turned

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Moro reflex
मोरो प्रतिवर्त: The Moro reflex is a startle response to a sudden change

C — Babinski reflex
बैबिन्स्की प्रतिवर्त: Babinski is the fanning of the toes on stroking the sole

D — Rooting reflex
रूटिंग प्रतिवर्त: Rooting is turning towards a touch on the cheek

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Persistence of primitive reflexes may indicate neurological problems
option_2:
Asymmetric tonic neck reflex
असममित टॉनिक नेक प्रतिवर्त

question:
A normal infant usually starts to social-smile at about:

सामान्य शिशु प्रायः कितने समय में सामाजिक मुस्कान देने लगता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. 2 months

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Social smiling usually begins at about two months

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 1 month: At one month smiling is often reflex

B — 6 months: By six months the baby smiles readily and laughs

C — 2 weeks: Two weeks is too early

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Delayed milestones need assessment, because early intervention helps the child

question:
A child is brought after swallowing kerosene. The nurse should:

एक बच्चे को मिट्टी के तेल निगलने के बाद लाया गया है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Keep the child nil by mouth, give oxygen if needed and refer urgently
बच्चे को मुँह से कुछ न दें, आवश्यकता पर ऑक्सीजन दें और तुरंत भेजें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Vomiting is not induced after hydrocarbon ingestion, as it causes aspiration; the child is kept nil by mouth and referred

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Induce vomiting at once
तुरंत उल्टी कराएँ: Induced vomiting risks severe lung injury

B — Give strong salt water
अधिक नमक वाला पानी दें: Salt water is dangerous and can cause harm

C — Give milk freely
खुलकर दूध दें: Large volumes of fluid may cause vomiting

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Never induce vomiting after kerosene or corrosive ingestion, because it damages the lungs or oesophagus
option_2:
Give strong salt water
अधिक नमक वाला पानी दें
option_4:
Keep the child nil by mouth, give oxygen if needed and refer urgently
बच्चे को मुँह से कुछ न दें, आवश्यकता पर ऑक्सीजन दें और तुरंत भेजें

question:
A child who has temper tantrums should be managed by:

गुस्से के दौरे वाले बच्चे का प्रबंधन कैसे करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Staying calm and ignoring the tantrum while keeping the child safe
शांत रहना और बच्चे को सुरक्षित रखते हुए दौरे को नजरअंदाज करना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Staying calm and not rewarding the tantrum reduces its frequency

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Shouting back
पलटकर चिल्लाना: Shouting escalates the behaviour

B — Physical punishment
शारीरिक दंड: Physical punishment is harmful

C — Giving in to every demand
हर माँग मान लेना: Giving in reinforces the tantrum

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Set consistent limits with warmth, and praise good behaviour
option_3:
Giving in to every demand
हर माँग मान लेना
option_4:
Staying calm and ignoring the tantrum while keeping the child safe
शांत रहना और बच्चे को सुरक्षित रखते हुए दौरे को नजरअंदाज करना

question:
A mother says her toddler refuses food and only wants milk. The nurse should advise her to:

माँ बताती है कि उसका छोटा बच्चा खाना नहीं खाता और केवल दूध चाहता है। नर्स को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Reduce milk feeds and offer small, frequent, attractive family foods
दूध कम करें और छोटे, बार-बार आकर्षक पारिवारिक भोजन दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Too much milk reduces appetite, so milk is moderated and attractive small meals are offered

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give milk all day
पूरे दिन दूध दें: All-day milk keeps the child full and malnourished

B — Stop all food
सारा भोजन बंद करें: Stopping food is harmful

C — Force-feed the child
बच्चे को जबरदस्ती खिलाएँ: Force-feeding creates a feeding aversion

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Toddlers have small stomachs and eat better with small frequent meals
option_1:
Give milk all day
पूरे दिन दूध दें
option_4:
Reduce milk feeds and offer small, frequent, attractive family foods
दूध कम करें और छोटे, बार-बार आकर्षक पारिवारिक भोजन दें

question:
The valve between the left atrium and the left ventricle is the:

बाएँ आलिंद और बाएँ निलय के बीच का वाल्व कौन-सा है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Mitral valve
माइट्रल वाल्व

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The mitral valve lies between the left atrium and the left ventricle

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Tricuspid valve
ट्राइकस्पिड वाल्व: The tricuspid valve is on the right side

C — Aortic valve
महाधमनी वाल्व: The aortic valve is at the outlet of the left ventricle

D — Pulmonary valve
फुफ्फुसीय वाल्व: The pulmonary valve is at the outlet of the right ventricle

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Valve disease causes murmurs and may lead to heart failure

question:
The normal stimulus to breathe is a rise in:

साँस लेने का सामान्य प्रेरक किसका बढ़ना है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Blood carbon dioxide
रक्त कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A rise in carbon dioxide stimulates the respiratory centre and increases breathing

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Blood oxygen
रक्त ऑक्सीजन: A fall in oxygen is a weaker stimulus

B — Blood glucose
रक्त ग्लूकोज: Glucose does not drive breathing

D — Blood calcium
रक्त कैल्शियम: Calcium does not drive breathing

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: In chronic carbon dioxide retention, the drive depends more on oxygen, so uncontrolled oxygen can suppress breathing

question:
The main function of the large intestine is to:

बड़ी आँत का मुख्य कार्य क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Absorb water and electrolytes and form stool
पानी और विद्युत-अपघट्य अवशोषित करना और मल बनाना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The large intestine absorbs water and electrolytes and forms stool

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Store bile
पित्त भंडारण: Bile is stored in the gall bladder

C — Produce insulin
इंसुलिन बनाना: Insulin comes from the pancreas

D — Digest protein
प्रोटीन पचाना: Protein digestion occurs in the stomach and small intestine

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Poor water absorption in the large intestine causes diarrhoea
option_1:
Absorb water and electrolytes and form stool
पानी और विद्युत-अपघट्य अवशोषित करना और मल बनाना

question:
About two-thirds of the total body water is found in the:

कुल शरीर जल का लगभग दो-तिहाई भाग कहाँ होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Intracellular compartment
अंतरा-कोशिकीय खंड

🧠 Clinical Rationale: About two-thirds of body water is inside the cells

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Extracellular compartment
बाह्य-कोशिकीय खंड: One-third is extracellular

B — Plasma
प्लाज्मा: Plasma is a small part of the extracellular fluid

D — Interstitial fluid
अंतरालीय द्रव: Interstitial fluid is part of the extracellular fluid

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Fluid shifts between these compartments cause oedema or dehydration

question:
Parathyroid hormone mainly:

पैराथायरॉइड हार्मोन मुख्यतः क्या करता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Raises blood calcium
रक्त कैल्शियम बढ़ाता है

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Parathyroid hormone raises blood calcium by acting on bone, gut and kidney

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Lowers blood calcium
रक्त कैल्शियम कम करता है: It raises, not lowers, calcium

B — Raises blood sodium
रक्त सोडियम बढ़ाता है: Aldosterone affects sodium

D — Lowers blood glucose
रक्त शर्करा कम करता है: Insulin lowers blood glucose

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Its removal during thyroid surgery causes hypocalcaemia with tingling and cramps
option_1:
Lowers blood calcium
रक्त कैल्शियम कम करता है
option_4:
Lowers blood glucose
रक्त शर्करा कम करता है

question:
A patient with schizophrenia says voices are telling him not to eat. The nurse should:

सिज़ोफ्रेनिया वाला रोगी कहता है कि आवाजें उसे खाने से मना कर रही हैं। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Accept the distress, ensure nutrition and report the command hallucinations
तकलीफ स्वीकारें, पोषण सुनिश्चित करें और आदेशात्मक मतिभ्रम की रिपोर्ट करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The distress is accepted without arguing, nutrition is supported and command hallucinations are reported

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Argue with the voices
आवाजों से बहस करें: Arguing reinforces the experience and damages trust

C — Ignore the patient
रोगी को नजरअंदाज करें: Ignoring the patient is unsafe

D — Force-feed roughly
जोर-जबरदस्ती खिलाएँ: Rough force-feeding harms the patient

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: Command hallucinations can be dangerous, so close observation and the prescribed drugs are important
option_1:
Accept the distress, ensure nutrition and report the command hallucinations
तकलीफ स्वीकारें, पोषण सुनिश्चित करें और आदेशात्मक मतिभ्रम की रिपोर्ट करें
option_2:
Argue with the voices
आवाजों से बहस करें

question:
An adolescent who is withdrawn and has falling grades should be:

जो किशोर अलग-थलग है और अंक गिर रहे हैं उसके साथ क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Assessed supportively for depression or stress and given a chance to talk
सहानुभूतिपूर्वक अवसाद या तनाव के लिए जाँचें और बात करने का मौका दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Withdrawal and falling grades may signal depression or stress, so supportive assessment is needed

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Punished for low marks
कम अंकों के लिए दंड दें: Punishment worsens distress

C — Ignored as normal
सामान्य मानकर नजरअंदाज करें: Ignoring these signs delays help

D — Given sedatives at once
तुरंत नींद की दवा दें: Sedatives are not the first step

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: Ask directly about mood and any thoughts of self-harm, because adolescents may not volunteer them
option_1:
Assessed supportively for depression or stress and given a chance to talk
सहानुभूतिपूर्वक अवसाद या तनाव के लिए जाँचें और बात करने का मौका दें
option_2:
